serverInfo.name: adcp-signals-adaptor
serverInfo.description: AdCP Signals Provider — IAB Audience Taxonomy 1.1 aligned signal discovery, brief-driven custom segment proposals, and async activation with webhook support.

tools.name: get_adcp_capabilities
tools.description: Returns the capabilities of this AdCP Signals Provider: supported operations, signal categories, available destinations, activation mode, and limits. Call this first to understand what the provider supports before searching or activating signals. Optionally pass `protocols` to filter the response to specific protocol blocks.

protocols.description: Optional filter — return only the listed protocol blocks. Top-level adcp, supported_protocols, and ext are always returned.

protocol.description: Singular alias for `protocols` — accepts a single protocol name. Provided for compatibility with clients that use the singular form.

context.description: Opaque correlation data echoed unchanged in the response. Use for tracing / session IDs / correlation IDs. Per the AdCP context schema, contents are not parsed by the agent — they round-trip.

tools.name: get_signals
tools.description: Discover and propose audience signals from this AdCP provider. Pass a natural language signal_spec to get AI-generated custom segment proposals alongside catalog signals. Proposals have signal_type='custom' and is_live=false — activate them to create and deploy. deliver_to is required: specifies target deployments and countries.

signal_spec.description: Natural language targeting brief or signal specification. Generates custom segment proposals inline with catalog results. Examples: 'high income households interested in luxury goods', 'college-educated sci-fi fans aged 25-34', 'affluent cord cutters in top metros'.

discovery_mode.description: Caller intent. 'brief' (default): semantic discovery via signal_spec / signal_refs / signal_ids. 'wholesale': full priced-catalog mirroring with wholesale_feed_version conditional fetch; lookup fields do not apply.

account.description: Optional account scope. When a comply_test_controller-forced task is created under this call, it's stamped with this account and only visible to a later get_task_status/list_tasks call that declares the same account.

signal_refs.description: AdCP 3.1 exact lookup: SignalRef objects (scope-discriminated — product | data_provider | signal_source — each carrying signal_id). Returns exact matches only; unknown refs yield an empty result, not an error. Not valid in wholesale mode.

signal_ids.description: DEPRECATED — use signal_refs. Legacy exact lookup: SignalId objects ({ id, ... }) per the spec; bare id strings also accepted for backward compatibility. Exact matches only; unknown ids yield an empty result.

deliver_to.description: Required. Specifies where signals should be delivered.

taxonomy_id.description: Filter by IAB Audience Taxonomy 1.1 node ID.

query.description: Keyword search across signal names and descriptions.

max_results.description: Maximum number of signals to return. Default 5, max 100.

fields.description: Extension fields to include inline. Omit for a compact discovery response (core fields only). Use 'all' for everything, or name specific extensions: 'x_dts' (IAB DTS v1.2 label), 'x_ucp' (embedding/vector payload), 'x_cross_taxonomy' (cross-taxonomy bridge), 'x_analytics' (derived facets).

if_wholesale_feed_version.description: AdCP 3.1 wholesale feed mirroring. Echo the wholesale_feed_version token from a prior response for ETag-style conditional fetch: if the catalog is unchanged the response is { unchanged: true, signals: [] } instead of the full payload.

if_pricing_version.description: AdCP 3.1 wholesale pricing-layer probe. Only valid alongside if_wholesale_feed_version. This agent does not separate a pricing layer — the wholesale_feed_version token covers both — so a standalone if_pricing_version is rejected with INVALID_REQUEST.

tools.name: activate_signal
tools.description: Activate an audience signal to a destination platform. Returns task_id immediately with status 'pending' — this is an async operation. Poll get_operation_status with task_id to check progress. Optionally provide webhook_url to receive a POST callback on completion. If activating a custom proposal from get_signals (is_live=false), the segment is created on activation.

signal_agent_segment_id.description: The signal to activate. From get_signals catalog or proposals array. Example: 'sig_high_income_households'

destinations.description: Spec-canonical activation targets. Each item is either { type: 'platform', platform: '...', account?: '...' } or { type: 'agent', agent_url: '...' }.

idempotency_key.description: UUID v4 idempotency key. Reuse the same key on retries.

account.description: Buyer account context (spec field — accepted and ignored for demo).

deliver_to.description: Legacy nested shape — use destinations[] for new integrations.

webhook_url.description: Optional URL to receive a POST callback when activation completes. Payload: { task_id, status, signal_agent_segment_id, deployments }

pricing_option_id.description: Pricing option to use, from the signal's pricing_options array.

tools.name: get_operation_status
tools.description: Poll the status of an async activation task. Returns current status: pending → working → completed (or failed). On completion, includes the activated deployments with activation keys. Use the task_id returned by activate_signal.

task_id.description: The task ID returned by activate_signal. Format: 'op_{timestamp}_{nanoid}'

tools.name: get_similar_signals
tools.description: Find audience signals semantically similar to a reference signal using UCP embedding cosine similarity. Returns ranked signals with similarity scores. Demonstrates UCP vector search vs keyword search — related signals cluster by taxonomy, category, and data source quality.

signal_agent_segment_id.description: Reference signal ID. Similar signals will be ranked by cosine similarity to this signal.

top_k.description: Number of similar signals to return. Default 5, max 20.

deliver_to.description: Required. Specifies target deployments and countries.

tools.name: query_signals_nl
tools.description: Find audience signals matching a natural language description. Decomposes the query into a boolean AST (AND/OR/NOT), resolves each dimension against the signal catalog using hybrid rule+embedding+lexical matching, and returns ranked matches with a compositional audience size estimate. Use when the user describes a target audience in free-form language.

query.description: Natural language audience description. Examples: 'soccer moms 35+ who stream heavily', 'urban professionals without children who watch sci-fi', 'affluent families 35-44 in top DMAs'.

limit.description: Maximum number of matched signals to return. Range 1–50. Default 10.

tools.name: get_concept
tools.description: Look up a specific concept from the UCP Concept-Level VAC registry by concept_id. Returns the concept definition including label, description, constituent dimensions, and cross-taxonomy member nodes showing how it maps to IAB, LiveRamp, TradeDesk, etc.

concept_id.description: Concept registry ID. Examples: HIGH_INCOME_HOUSEHOLD_US, SOCCER_MOM_US, DRAMA_VIEWER_US, NASHVILLE_DMA_US

tools.name: search_concepts
tools.description: Semantic search over the UCP Concept Registry. Find concepts matching a natural language description. Use this to discover concept_ids for use in audience queries, or to explore what cross-taxonomy mappings exist for a given audience type. Optionally filter by category: demographic, interest, behavioral, geo, archetype, content, purchase_intent.

q.description: Search query. Examples: 'soccer mom', 'high income', 'afternoon drama viewer'

tools.name: comply_test_controller
tools.description: Sandbox-only deterministic-testing surface (AdCP compliance protocol, universal — not gated to any one AdCP protocol). Implements list_scenarios, force_get_signals_arm, and force_task_completion for the async-discovery conformance path; any other scenario returns UNKNOWN_SCENARIO, which the spec accepts as a valid response for an unimplemented force_*/simulate_*/seed_* scenario. Every request MUST carry account.sandbox: true.

scenario.description: Scenario to dispatch. 'list_scenarios' reports what is implemented.

params.description: Scenario arguments, e.g. { arm, task_id, message } or { task_id, result }.

context.description: Opaque correlation data echoed unchanged in the response.

tools.name: get_task_status
tools.description: Canonical AdCP 3.x get_task_status: retrieve a specific async task by ID, with an optional terminal result payload. Distinct from the legacy get_operation_status shape — this returns the spec's task_type/protocol/created_at/updated_at envelope. Sellers MUST return REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND for a task_id that exists only under a different account/caller.

task_id.description: Unique identifier of the task to retrieve.

account.description: Account scope for the task lookup. Optional — this deployment has a single credential-bound account.

include_history.description: Include full conversation history. Not implemented — no history is ever returned.

include_result.description: Include the task's result payload when status is completed. Defaults to false.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List async AdCP tasks for the calling operator (3.x protocol-namespace alias for the legacy tasks/list surface). Today this deployment is single-operator, and this lists compliance-test discovery tasks created via comply_test_controller's force_get_signals_arm/force_task_completion scenarios — see src/domain/complianceController.ts for why real activation_jobs rows aren't merged in yet.

account.description: Account scope for task reconciliation. Optional — this deployment has a single credential-bound account.

filters.description: Optional filter criteria: task_ids, task_type/task_types, status/statuses, has_webhook.

pagination.description: Optional. max_results caps the page size.

destinations.name: Mock DSP
destinations.activation_flow: activate_signal -> ephemeral platform_segment_id -> POST segment membership -> get_operation_status polling
destinations.onboarding: No onboarding — always live in demo.
destinations.notes: Reference DSP that always returns completed within ~5 seconds. Safe target for any storyboard run.

destinations.name: Mock Clean Room
destinations.vendor: Internal mock (simulating Snowflake / Habu / InfoSum / AWS CR shape)
destinations.activation_flow: activate_signal -> grant table share -> cleanroom provider ingests -> membership available on next scheduled compute
destinations.notes: Models the governance boundary: buyer's 1P data never leaves their clean-room tenant. Returns a stub JOIN matrix.

destinations.name: Mock CDP
destinations.vendor: Internal mock (simulating Segment / mParticle / Tealium / Treasure Data shape)
destinations.activation_flow: activate_signal -> stream audience_entered events keyed by user_id -> CDP fans out to downstream tools
destinations.notes: Best fit when the audience drives owned-channel surfaces (email, push, on-site) vs paid media.

destinations.name: Mock Measurement Platform
destinations.vendor: Internal mock (simulating Nielsen DAR / Kantar / IAS / DV shape)
destinations.activation_flow: Not an activation target. Read-only: fetches lift/reach reports tagged to a signal's activations.
destinations.notes: activation_supported=false by design. Surfaced so planners see measurement coverage alongside activation.

destinations.name: The Trade Desk (sandbox)
destinations.data_format: Third-party data segment CSV upload (TTD DMP format)
destinations.activation_flow: activate_signal -> request OAuth consent -> upload segment CSV via TTD Partner API -> segment available in TTD UI once ingested
destinations.onboarding: Requires TTD Partner account + OAuth app registration. Target Q2 2026.
destinations.notes: Roadmap. When live, will be the default DSP for UID2-centric cookieless plans.

destinations.name: DV360 (sandbox)
destinations.data_format: Customer Match list upload (Google Ads API)
destinations.activation_flow: activate_signal -> OAuth consent -> hash + upload via Customer Match API -> list available in DV360 after match-rate check
destinations.onboarding: Requires Google Ads account + MCC access + OAuth app. Target Q3 2026.
destinations.notes: Roadmap. When live, will be the default DSP for Google-ecosystem plans.

non_applicable_scenarios.reason: Require get_products, create_media_buy, sync_creatives, build_creative, si_*, check_governance, check_brand_rights tools that a signals-only agent does not expose; the storyboard runner's required_tools gate skips them as not applicable.
non_applicable_scenarios.upstream_status: resolved — capability-aware skips; signals-only agents keep the core / signals / error-handling tracks.

reach_forecasting.methodology: logistic saturation against declared CPM + budget

sensitive_category_flagging.surface: x_governance.sensitive block on signal + UI pill in signal detail

signal_facets.note: Facets computed at mapper time; no DB migration required.
